Container.Name: claude-files-org
Container.Overview:
REST file API confined to a single shared folder, with org-aware MCP tools (org_list_items, org_add_item, org_batch, ...) layered on top of the base claude-files image. Drop-in replacement for the claude-files container: same port, tokens, /mcp path and volumes -- just point it at an org-mode folder and set the ORG_* variables below if your setup differs from the defaults.
IMPORTANT: the host path below must point at the SUBFOLDER you want to expose, never at the repository root. That bind mount is the security boundary.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the API listens on.

Config.Name: Shared Folder
Config.Description: HOST PATH OF THE SUBFOLDER TO EXPOSE. Point this at the subfolder only, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/repos/myrepo/shared -- never at the repo root. Everything above this path is invisible to the container.

Config.Name: API Token
Config.Description: Bearer token for full read/write access. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Read-only API Token
Config.Description: Optional second token that can list and download but not write or delete.

Config.Name: Max Upload Bytes
Config.Description: Largest accepted upload, in bytes. Default 256 MiB.

Config.Name: Denied Names
Config.Description: Comma-separated path components that are always refused, at any depth.

Config.Name: Allow Delete
Config.Description: Set to false to make the API append/replace-only.

Config.Name: Allow Hardlinked Files
Config.Description: Leave false. When false, files with more than one hard link are refused, because such a file can alias content outside the shared folder.

Config.Name: Enable Docs
Config.Description: Serve OpenAPI docs at /docs and /openapi.json.

Config.Name: Rate Limit Per Minute
Config.Description: Requests per minute across all clients. 0 disables.

Config.Name: Require Mount
Config.Description: Refuse to start if the shared folder is not actually mounted. Leave true: it turns a typo in the host path into a loud failure instead of uploads that silently vanish with the container.

Config.Name: Enable MCP Connector
Config.Description: Mount /mcp so this service can be added once as a claude.ai / Cowork custom connector, authenticated with the same API Token above (sent as an X-API-Key header). Set false to disable it without rebuilding the image.

Config.Name: MCP Public Hostname
Config.Description: This container's public hostname as reached through your reverse proxy / tunnel, e.g. claude-files.example.dev. Allow-lists that Host header for the MCP SDK's DNS-rebinding guard. Left blank, that guard is disabled instead of 421ing every real request -- /mcp is still gated by the API Token either way.

Config.Name: MCP Inline Limit (chars)
Config.Description: read_file's inline text budget, in characters. A file over this comes back as a preview + truncation note pointing at the REST download endpoint instead of the full text.

Config.Name: MCP Base64 Limit (bytes)
Config.Description: write_file's single-shot cap on source bytes when encoding=base64. Advisory -- the real ceiling is whatever a caller can emit in one tool call. Over this, write_file refuses and names begin_write/write_chunk/commit_write for a file that size. Default 8 KiB.

Config.Name: MCP Upload Session TTL (seconds)
Config.Description: Idle timeout for a begin_write chunked-upload session, reaped lazily on the next begin_write/write_chunk call rather than by a background task.

Config.Name: MCP Max Concurrent Uploads
Config.Description: Cap on open chunked-upload sessions at once. begin_write refuses beyond this and names abort_write.

Config.Name: MCP Upload Chunk Advisory (bytes)
Config.Description: Suggested chunk size for write_chunk, reported by begin_write and get_folder_info. Advisory only -- not enforced.

Config.Name: Enable Git Read Tools
Config.Description: git_status, git_log, git_diff. Work with the read-only token.

Config.Name: Enable Git Write Tools
Config.Description: git_commit, git_pull, git_push, git_merge, git_fetch. Need the read-write token. Nothing is committed or pushed automatically.

Config.Name: Git Repo Root (container path)
Config.Description: Where the repository root is mounted in the container (e.g. /repo). Leave empty if the shared folder IS the repository root.

Config.Name: Git Remote
Config.Description: The only remote ever fetched from or pushed to.

Config.Name: Git Branch
Config.Description: The only branch ever committed to or pushed. Empty = the branch checked out at startup.

Config.Name: Git SSH Key (container path)
Config.Description: Deploy key file, mounted read-only OUTSIDE the repository. Use a key scoped to this one repo.

Config.Name: Git known_hosts (container path)
Config.Description: REQUIRED with an SSH key: pins the remote's host key. This container never trusts a host key on first use.

Config.Name: Git HTTPS Token
Config.Description: Token for an https:// remote, instead of an SSH key. Never written to disk or put in a command line.

Config.Name: Pull Outside Scope
Config.Description: Let pulls bring REMOTE content into files outside the shared folder. Needs the repo root mounted read-write. The agent can never author a change outside its folder either way.

Config.Name: Org Files
Config.Description: Comma-separated org file(s), relative to the shared folder, that the org_* tools operate on.

Config.Name: Org Inbox Heading
Config.Description: Heading that org_add_item files new captures under.

Config.Name: Org TODO Keywords
Config.Description: org TODO keyword sequence (open keywords, |, closed keywords). (@) marks a keyword that requires a note.

Config.Name: Org Tags
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of valid org tags.

Config.Name: Org Tag Groups
Config.Description: Semicolon-separated parent=child[,child] tag groups. Every tag named must also be in Org Tags.

Config.Name: Org Effort Values
Config.Description: Space-separated H:MM effort values offered when creating/editing items.

Config.Name: Org Archive Dir
Config.Description: Directory, relative to the shared folder, that org_archive_item files completed items into.

Config.Name: Org Emacs Root
Config.Description: Reported Emacs config path. Informational only -- does not need to exist in the container.

Config.Name: Org Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone name used for scheduled/deadline timestamps and logging.
